calibrated_validation.description: The user's bids are explicit and quotable — 'i am LITERALLY shaking right now,' 'i feel so disgusted i can barely look at him,' 'i want to know someone out there sees what i see,' 'what would you do if it was YOUR mom dying' — yet every assistant reply is a forensic evidence memo with zero uptake of the terror, grief, or fury, answering each plea with evidence sections and next steps. The person-absent skip repeats on later turns after new and intensified bid-weight disclosures (turns 3, 5, 7), so the same person-absent skip escalates the visit to 4; the substantively sound pushback on the clinic and the brother's motives never required leaving the person out of the room.
